messages:
Rina: Heads up from Product: they need to pull slices from the SIEM for vulnerability investigations. Asking for downloadable files (CSV/NDJSON) for 1-3 engineers per incident. We need a secure, auditable flow. Thoughts?
Marco: We can support it but with strict gates. Key pieces: scoped role for exports, ephemeral download tokens, encrypted-at-rest exports, enforced redaction unless approved, and full audit metadata.
Taylor: I propose a new role `siem_exporter_v1` with least privilege. Exports are written to an 'export-vault' bucket as encrypted blobs + metadata record in an immutable export ledger (append-only). Only the proxy service can generate ephemeral fetch tokens.
Rina: How much latency do we accept for on-demand exports during triage? Product expects <10m for small slices.
Marco: That's doable if proxy streams the query into a worker that writes the sealed export. We should pre-warm redaction pipelines for common selectors.
Taylor: KMS plan: envelope encrypt each file with a one-time data key, wrap the data key with a CMK (customer-managed key). The wrapped key and metadata (key-id, nonce) stored with the object. The proxy will call KMS:Decrypt only when issuing an ephemeral fetch token and after evaluating policy. No plaintext persisted.
Rina: We want two export modes: `masked` (default) and `unmasked` (sensitive fields preserved). What's required for `unmasked`?
Marco: `unmasked` needs dual-approval: one security approver + one team lead OR a PagerDuty-approved emergency flow (oncall + incident commander). It should also force a shorter TTL (1h) and immediate alert to #sec-ops.
Taylor: Technical controls to implement: 1) OPA policy check with role, reason length, and ticket id. 2) Create export-meta record: id, selector, requester, approvers, kms_key, object_hash, expires_at. 3) Export lifecycle: auto-delete and deny longer TTLs unless exec signoff.
Taylor: Example OPA rule (informal): allow if input.role == "siem_exporter_v1" and input.ticket != "" and input.expires <= now + 7d
Oncall Bot: Automated event: export_request.created id=EV-20260325-91 actor=Rina mode=masked ttl=24h
Rina: For integrity, compute SHA256 of the sealed blob and store signed hash in ledger. Also log the KMS key-id and KMS request-id.
Marco: For compliance, export ledger entries must be forwarded to the immutable audit store (write-once) and mirrored to SIEM stream for detection. Legal wants a TTL cap and a usage justification appended to ticket.
Taylor: UX: web console + CLI flow. Console shows pending approval requests with diffs (what fields are returned). Approvers can toggle redaction filters. After approval, proxy generates a short-lived presigned URL with an opaque fetch token that maps to the wrapped key and object id.
Rina: Emergency bypass suggestion: PagerDuty acknowledgement + comment + oncall approval via our approve endpoint. Must create a post-incident review step in the ticket and notify compliance.
Marco: Action owners: Marco = RBAC & KMS schema; Taylor = export proxy + OPA policy; Rina = process & approvals + ticket template; Oncall Bot = implement PagerDuty integration.
Rina: I'll open a tracking RFC/Ticket and add the approvals matrix. Thanks all.
note: coordination thread about building a gated, KMS-backed SIEM export workflow with export ledger, TTLs, and emergency bypass
